correctness.rationale: The unique cusp and unique tangent force each projective automorphism to act affine-linearly on the t-parametrized normalization. Polynomial coefficient comparison gives the exhaustive \(\alpha^{q+1}=1\) group for \(q\ge4\) and the \(\alpha^3=1\), beta arbitrary exception for \(q=2\). Linearization of the exact homogeneous F leaves precisely three independent middle-row parameters modulo scalar matrices. Explicit Frobenius substitution verifies a closed finite group scheme with coordinate-ring length \(q^3(q+1)\). The standalone checker independently enumerates PGL3(F2) for \(q=2\),4,8,16 and recomputes Lie ranks; finite checks are not used as a proof for arbitrary q.

value.rationale: A complete classification for an infinite family of high-degree singular rational plane curves gives a sharp reduced-symmetry transition between degree four and higher degrees. The persistent Lie dimension three and explicit nilpotent subgroup of increasing length quantify a non-smooth projective-stabilizer phenomenon invisible to pointwise automorphism calculations. This is naturally relevant to positive-characteristic equivariant geometry of Kollár’s exceptional non-liftable curves and is not just a genus or singularity restatement.
